stage1.impression: A strong idea: eight glowing cabinets at the foot of a concrete wall, their colours mixing up the wall as a spectrum, with a wet foreground and a river. As executed it reads as a moody gallery CG render, not a photograph of a river front. The products are small (about 80 px of 1440) and their horns vanish into the wall, the fronts clip to near-white, a dead black stripe cuts the reflections, the board-form texture visibly repeats and denoise smear is visible in the speakers and reflections. Nothing tells you it is outdoors by a river.

blocking_9: Each speaker reads whole at a glance: horn separated from the wall (horn lum at least 12 above the wall behind it), cabinets filling about 85% of the frame width
No blown fronts: clip_pct under 3% in every cabinet body, so the eight colours, Fog included, stay saturated
No crushed dead band between paving and river; the wet stone and water carry continuous reflections down to the bottom edge
Board-formed concrete with no visible repeat of tie holes or stains across the 60 m wall
Clean noise and no denoiser painting in the cabinets, voile and reflections at full 2880 px
One cue that this is outdoors at night by a river (the wall's top edge against night sky, or more of the river and the far-bank glow)
The right sixth of the frame not a black void: either balanced by framing or lifted by moonlight

defects.what: Horns on top read as dark grey blocks the same value as the wall (horn lum 43 vs wall 42), so silhouettes are lost
Cabinet fronts clip 4-12% (Ember 12%, Ice 8%, Dust/Acid 8%); colours wash toward white
Full-width crushed black stripe (lum median 1.8, 82% crushed) between the paving reflections and the river, reads as a void
Concrete texture repeats: identical tie-hole and stain clusters recur panel to panel
Right edge falls to near black (lum median 24.5) while the left is saturated red; frame is lopsided, speakers sit left of centre (left margin 145 px, right 235 px)
Denoiser smear: reflections and the cabinets' interiors look painted, with blotchy edges

Wall brightest at the top of frame (profile 77-97) and dimmer just above the horns (42), so washes do not visibly rise from the lights; the wall's top is cropped so monumentality and the outdoor setting are not shown
The river is a 28 px strip at the bottom edge; reflections are cut off

changes.problem: The product is too small to be the hero and the row sits left of centre.

evidence.measured: each cabinet about 80 px wide of 1440 (5.5%); row spans x 145-1205, margins 145 left vs 235 right

change.to: position [0.0, -9.4, 0.6], target [0.0, 0.0, 1.6], lens 32 mm, level true

changes.expected: Row fills about 84% of frame width with equal margins; cabinets about 95 px wide at this staging size; more of the wet paving reflection enters the frame.

changes.problem: The uplights blow out the cabinet fronts so the colours wash to white.

evidence.measured: Ice body clip_pct 11.1, p95 233; Ember 12.0%, Dust 7.8%, Acid 7.7%

changes.expected: Body clip under 3%, each cabinet's tint saturated; wall mid still around lum 60-70.

changes.problem: The horns get no light and disappear against the wall; the right side of the frame is a void.

evidence.measured: horn lum median 42.8 vs wall beside it about 42; right edge [1250,0,1440,300] lum median 24.5

change.to: irradiance 0.09, position [10, -12, 16] (high, front right, so it tops the horns and lifts the right end), colour #C4D0F0 kept

changes.expected: A cool sheen on the horn tops and rims separating them from the wall; right end of wall lifts to lum 35-45 without competing with the washes.

changes.problem: A crushed black stripe across the full width cuts the paving reflection off from the river.

change.from: edge colour #3A3936 roughness 0.6; paving wet 1.0, puddle_m 2.5
change.to: edge colour #6A6862 roughness 0.35 (wet granite coping that catches moon and the washes); paving wet 0.8, puddle_m 1.2 so the reflections stretch down the stone; sky strength 0.035 to 0.06 so wet stone shows sky instead of black

changes.expected: The band carries smeared coloured streaks and a lit coping line; no full-width void.

changes.problem: The board-formed concrete visibly tiles, which says render.

evidence.measured: seen: the same tie-hole and stain clusters repeat in adjacent bays at the same height

change.to: vary 0.35, vary_m 1.6, a random texture offset and 180-degree flip per pilaster and per bay; bump 1.2 to 1.6 for deeper board grain

changes.expected: No recognisable repeat; tone variation pour by pour like a real cast wall.

changes.problem: Denoiser smear paints the reflections and the voile inside the cabinets.

evidence.measured: seen at 2-3x: blotchy, painterly edges in the reflections and cabinet interiors

change.to: double the samples (at least 1024), denoise with albedo and normal prefilter accurate, light clamp indirect 10

changes.expected: Grain-free but textured reflections, crisp batt and voile edges.

changes.problem: Nothing places the scene outdoors at an opera house by a river; it reads as an interior gallery.

evidence.measured: wall fills the whole top to the frame edge, no sky, no cornice; river only 28 px at the bottom

change.setting: set.props.0 wall size and set.props.2 cornice
change.from: wall 24 m tall, cornice at z 11 out of frame
change.to: lower the wall to 8 m with the cornice (props.2) at z 7.5 so the wall's top edge and a band of night sky (kloppenheim, strength 0.06) show in the top 10% of frame

changes.expected: A dark sky band above a lit cornice line tells you it is outside; the wall still fills most of the frame and keeps room for type.

out_of_scope.request: Let light reach the horn from the uplight so it glows like the cabinet
out_of_scope.why: The lining and the cabinet stop the light; the horn can only be lit by the moon or bounce, handled in c3.

out_of_scope.request: Make the Smoke black cabinet throw a stronger wash to balance the right side
out_of_scope.why: Its colour is fixed; balance has to come from framing and moonlight.
